validation_rules: Verify repository == kokizzu/instrumentfx before every research write; edrums is a reference only.
Sum of page counts and inventory lengths must equal record_count; model names must be unique across pages.
Unknown values stay null or unverified, never implicit false or zero.
No screen size is estimated from photos or borrowed from a sibling model.
OLED/LCD/TFT technology is separate from monochrome/color and touch support.
Comparison price columns display IDR; foreign original prices are provenance only.
FX estimates require the original quote, verified rate, rate date and rate source.
An absent local price does not imply the model is unavailable in Indonesia.
No completed-sale claim may be inferred from an asking price.
Commit each researched model immediately, before starting the next; preserve scoped findings and advance the cursor after verified integration.
A first-pass review with saved unknowns is not full verification of a model.
Shopee listing evidence is not live checkout, seller authentication or confirmed condition.
Do not count discovery-only rows, accessories, digital presets or duplicate notes as technical model records.
Do not reset to baseline_research_commit, rewrite history or modify the separate edrums repository.
